name: Ranger: the Advantage bar keeps Skullpiercer rank 1 known to the client (#6424)
contract: #6424 The Ascension client (patch-B ClassResources.lua) shows the Ranger Advantage combo bar only while IsSpellIDKnown(802036), Skullpiercer rank 1, which the Ranger starts with in action button 3. Skullpiercer uses Focus, so SpellInfo::IsStackableWithRanks is false and learning rank 2, 501715 (level 10), superseded 802036: the client was told to replace it, and SendInitialSpells skipped the inactive rank on every later login, so the bar vanished at level 10 for good. Expected: after learning 501715, and after a relog, the client still knows 802036 and 501715 while the server keeps 501715 as the active rank and moves button 3 to it; rank 3, 501716 (level 18), still supersedes 501715 normally.

steps.label: a new Ranger's client knows Skullpiercer rank 1
rank 1 is no longer the active rank
the client still knows rank 1, so the Advantage bar stays
after a relog the client still knows rank 1
after a relog the client knows rank 2
after a relog button 3 still casts rank 2
the client still knows rank 1 at rank 3
